evidence: The XRD spectra for the TiO2-coated nickel and iron powders are shown in Figure 8. The decomposition of nickel oxalate in the FBR clearly did not run to completion, as evidenced by the two peaks at low diffraction angles, which correspond to the dehydrated nickel oxalate material. Since the TiO2 ALD films were amorphous at this deposition temperature, no TiO2 signal was present, as expected.
